lots.title: Provision of Fire Door Surveys
lots.description: Lot 4 of the 6278 Building Services Framework, run by the London Borough of Bexley, covering the provision of Fire Door Survey services. The extracted document content consists of Appendix 1 (referee Reference Form) and Appendix 2 (covering letter to referees) used to evaluate applicants for this lot. The extracted appendices do not include the full technical specification body, so the requirement set captured here is limited to the referee-scored performance areas and the project-delivery expectation explicitly named in the form.
requirements: Applicant must supply a named referee with verifiable contact details and a brief description of services provided and the value per annum of that prior contract.
Applicant must demonstrate capability to self-deliver small and medium Fire Door Survey projects (explicitly named in Part B, Project Management question).
Applicant must have held the necessary qualifications, certifications, and experience for tasks assigned on prior contracts and met required resource levels (Part B, Resource question).
Applicant must have provided a resilient and sustainable supply chain for required products, resources, and services on prior contracts (Part B, Supply chain resilience).
Applicant must have consistently delivered contracted services in line with required KPIs (Part B, Service Provision).
Applicant must have demonstrated effective contract management, including performance monitoring and oversight of subcontractors (Part B, Contract Management).
Applicant must have shown a transparent and well-evidenced approach to securing value for money (Part B, Value for Money).
The completed reference form must be returned by the referee directly to procurement@bexley.gov.uk by 18th May 2026 by 5pm and must not be returned to the applicant.

warnings.message: Extracted markdown contains only Appendix 1 (reference form) and Appendix 2 (covering letter to referees). The main technical specification body of the tender is not present in this extraction, so detailed scope, deliverables, service levels, acceptance criteria and schedule for Lot 4 could not be captured.

No technical standards (for example BS 8214, BS 476, BS 9999, PAS 24, NFDC, FDIS, ISO 9001) are cited in the extracted content. Technical standards array intentionally left empty rather than inferred.
The extracted document does not cite any CPV code. Notice-level CPV signals exist but were not taken as authoritative for the lot, per skill inputs guidance.

The referenced framework 6278 spans Lots 1-11, but the extracted appendix set is explicitly titled against Lot 4 only. No content for Lots 1-3 or 5-11 appears in this extraction and no cross-lot content was invented.
